name: Rosa Centifolia
notes: Designed by Rena Lab on HMX's new L3 mold with a rose-printed light guide. P7 is PA66 with 50% fiberglass. Sold as 37g/45g or 45g/53g, both on a 22 mm KOS single-stage spring. These are the 45g/53g ones. Stem legs and sliders have a thin coat of 205g0, spring and leaf are dry-film lubed. Specs from UniKeyboards, Divinikey, and kbd.news. Colors sampled from UniKeyboards photos.
